name: M.Sc. Project Part II
description: This is Part II of the M.Sc. Project, serving as a continuation of Part I under specified academic guidelines and evaluation criteria. In this course, students pursue an independent research project within a defined research theme, building upon the work initiated in Part I. The emphasis is on deepening theoretical foundations, conducting experimental and/or computational investigations, performing systematic data analysis, and further developing advanced critical thinking, problem-solving skills, and technical expertise in their specialized domain.
